ICS: Name  Point out a specific emotion the patient/family member might be feeling.
Understand  Empathize with/legitimize the emotion without conveying you understand what someone is feeling.
Respect  Accept their perspective, validate that their reaction is important, and/or give praise.
Support  Show support: demonstrate partnership or provide opportunities for family engagement.
Explore  Ask the patient to elaborate on the emotion.
Use open-ended questions to elicit a description of concerns
Sit at eye level with family member
Maintain appropriate eye contact throughout the visit
Actively engage family member (e.g. avoids external distractions, pocket reference pauses seem natural, leans forward and uses the family member’s name)
Listen without interruption, using silence to facilitate responses
